subject: Curelink: prompt/output retention closure & certification
messages:
From: Alice Roberts <alice.roberts@curelink.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@curelink.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to close retention window for Curelink tenant (prompt/output + traces)

Marcus —

We need to initiate a closure of retention for our Curelink tenant ID CL-9812. Scope: all prompt inputs, generated outputs, and request trace logs produced between 2024-11-01 and 2026-05-01. This is in support of a regulatory data-closure requirement for a product line sunsetting next month.

Can you confirm Redwood's workflow and the expected evidence we will receive once the work is complete? We will need an auditable manifest describing which objects were removed (S3 keys/paths), the deletion job IDs, and a signed attestation that the retained backups (if any) are out of scope or also removed.

Happy to provide a PO or an authorization email if that makes the process faster.

Thanks,
Alice Roberts
Head of Security Operations
Curelink, Inc.

--
Attachment: none
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Roberts <alice.roberts@curelink.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to close retention window for Curelink tenant (prompt/output + traces)

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the clear scope. We can execute a targeted removal for tenant CL-9812 covering:
- Prompt inputs stored in prompt_logs (S3 prefix: s3://redwood-prod/prompt-logs/tenants/CL-9812/)
- Generated outputs and artifacts (S3 prefix: s3://redwood-prod/outputs/CL-9812/)
- Request traces and audit logs older than 2026-05-01 (we will retain minimal audit entries for the purge operation itself).

High-level plan:
1) Authorization check: please confirm this email is the formal authorization (reply-all OK), or provide PO/DS signature.
2) Scheduling: we will schedule the job in a maintenance window (ETA 48–72 hours after authorization).
3) Dry run: generate a manifest CSV listing candidate keys for deletion and share for your review (no objects removed in this step).
4) Final deletion: run the job, collect deletion job IDs and S3 delete markers, and generate an immutable certificate (PDF) signed by our Compliance team.
5) Evidence delivery: we will deliver: purge manifest (CSV), deletion job IDs, S3 response snippets, and the signed deletion certificate.

Attachments: I am attaching our proposed purge plan (curelink_purge_plan_v1.pdf) which contains the exact prefixes and the rollback/fallback steps.

If you can authorize by EOD tomorrow we will target completion by Friday.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Lead — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: curelink_purge_plan_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2026 11:21:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Execution checklist for CL-9812 retention closure

Marcus / Karthik —

Looping in ops notes before we confirm schedule with Curelink. Summary of execution steps for the run:
- Verify tenant mapping in metadata DB (tenant_id -> prefix) and snapshot tenant configuration.
- Lock ingestion for CL-9812 for the duration of the job (10:00–12:00 UTC window).
- Run discovery lambda to enumerate objects and write s3_manifest_curelink_20260528.csv to a secure bucket with restricted ACL.
- Submit deletion batch to S3 using multi-object delete, record deletion IDs and ETags.
- KV cache / in-memory traces: clear any ephemeral caches linked to CL-9812; confirm eviction callbacks fired.
- Post-delete verification: attempt to GET a sample of removed keys (should 404).
- Generate deletion report and sign (compliance).

Note: Customer requested attestation that backups are also covered. For backups, we only manage short-term snapshot retention in our managed storage; long-term archival in customer-managed storage will require customer confirmation. I will prepare a short paragraph in the certificate clarifying this boundary.

I'll mark this as READY once discovery manifest is posted.

--
Attachment: none
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Roberts <alice.roberts@curelink.com>, security@curelink.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to close retention window for Curelink tenant (prompt/output + traces)

Alice —

Authorization received (reply attached). We executed the deletion for CL-9812 in the 10:00–12:00 UTC window today. Deliverables attached and summarized below.

Summary (what we removed):
- 18,742 prompt log objects under s3://redwood-prod/prompt-logs/tenants/CL-9812/ (range covered: 2024-11-01 to 2026-05-01)
- 6,101 generated output objects under s3://redwood-prod/outputs/CL-9812/
- 12,390 trace entries in request-traces older than 2026-05-01 (exported and removed)

Artifacts delivered (attached):
- s3_manifest_curelink_20260528.csv — CSV manifest of enumerated keys (sha256, key, size, last_modified)
- deletion-certification-20260528.pdf — Signed attestation from Redwood Compliance including the deletion job IDs (JOB-20260528-9917), S3 delete response snippets, and the statement on backup boundary: "Redwood-managed snapshots for the tenant were also removed where applicable; customer-managed archival systems were not altered."

Small notes and follow-ups:
- We left a short audit record (immutable) of the purge itself in our compliance log; that record references the job ID above.
- If you need a notarized or third-party attestation, we can coordinate an external auditor; that would be a separate engagement.

Please confirm receipt. If Curelink requires any additional metadata fields in the manifest, tell us which columns to add and we will republish.

Best regards,
Marcus Lin
Account Lead — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: s3_manifest_curelink_20260528.csv (text/csv), deletion-certification-20260528.pdf (application/pdf)
